summary.text: Scott Meyer is a Republican member of the North Dakota Senate representing District 18 (Grand Forks), serving since 2017. His standing committees in the 2025 regular session are Appropriations.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Meyer is a mortgage planner at Benchmark Mortgage with a BS in psychology from UND.

His biography lists a 2022 fellowship at the National Security Forum, Air War College, and Department of Defense certificates of appreciation in 2019 and 2021 for policy on the quality of life of service members and their families.
In the interim he serves on the Budget Section and the Higher Education Institutions Committee.
